reasons.preference_fit: 行程主要围绕海滨自然景观展开，天涯海角、三亚湾、亚龙湾海滩等符合用户偏好，但天涯小镇、崖州古城等文化景点占比略高
reasons.pacing: 每天安排3个景点，时间间隔2小时，节奏相对合理，但11:00-13:30和15:30-16:30存在空闲时段
reasons.geographic_coherence: 每天景点地理位置相对集中，天涯小镇-天涯海角-崖州古城；椰梦长廊-三亚湾-海月广场；后海村-亚龙湾海滩-海棠河生态公园，减少了不必要的往返
reasons.time_realism: 时间安排符合正常作息习惯，09:00开始，但连续3天中雨天气可能影响户外活动体验
reasons.completeness: 在给定scope下，路线信息完整，包含具体景点和时间安排
reasons.diversity_and_dining: 景点类型多样，涵盖自然景观、文化遗址和海滨活动，体验丰富

judges.overall_comment: 整体行程安排合理，符合海滨自然偏好，地理分布集中，但需注意中雨天气对户外活动的影响

reasons.preference_fit: Most spots align with '海滨自然' preference: 天涯海角游览区, 三亚湾, 亚龙湾海滩, 椰梦长廊, 后海村, 海棠河生态公园 all fit seaside/natural theme. 天涯小镇 and 崖州古城 are more urban/historical, reducing perfect fit.
reasons.pacing: Reasonable 2-hour sessions with 2-hour breaks between periods, but moderate rain all days (Oct 15-17) significantly impacts outdoor activity enjoyment and may cause delays.
reasons.geographic_coherence: Spots within each day appear geographically clustered: Day 1 (Tianxia Town→Tianya Bay→Yazhou Ancient City), Day 2 (Dream Corridor→Sanya Bay→Haiyue Square), Day 3 (Houhai Village→Yalong Bay→Haitang Park), suggesting minimal backtracking.
reasons.time_realism: Normal作息 timing (9-11am, 1:30-3:30pm, 4:30-6:30pm) is realistic, but moderate rain may extend travel times between outdoor spots.
reasons.completeness: Route provides complete structure with specific spots and times for all 3 days. Within scope constraints (meals=false, transport_legs=false), all necessary information is provided.
reasons.diversity_and_dining: Good diversity: natural attractions (beaches, parks), urban areas (towns, squares), and historical elements (ancient city). Dining not evaluated per scope.meals=false.

judges.overall_comment: Strong itinerary matching seaside/natural preferences with good geographic coherence and completeness. Moderate rain throughout the trip is the main challenge that may affect enjoyment and timing.
